marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Pop culture: a view from the papparazzi

"Lindsay Lohan started modeling at the age of three. Producers soon recognized her talent and appeal by casting her in dozens of TV commercials. At the age of 12, Lindsay Lohan burst onto the Hollywood film scene when she played two roles - twin sisters - in the Disney comedy 'The Parent Trap'. Soon, she would become a young actress in demand, starring in such films as 'Freaky Friday', 'Mean Girls', and 'Herbie : Fully Loaded'. But as Lindsay's star continued to rise, she found herself increasingly caught up in the Hollywood party scene. It didn't take long for Lindsay to develop a drinking problem, which she finally acknowledged by intereing a rehabilitation program. As she struggles to control her addiciton, Lindsay remains one of Hollywood's brightest and most talented stars, and has landed roles in such thought-provoking flms as 'Bobby' and 'A Prairie Home Companion'."
